description: This file contains middleware functions for authentication and tenant access control in a Node.js application, including JWT verification, tenant ID validation, and applying tenant filters to database queries.

methods.name: authTenant
methods.description: Middleware to authenticate requests using JWT, extracting user and tenant information, and attaching it to the request object.

methods.name: ensureTenantAccess
methods.description: Middleware to verify that the tenant ID in the request path matches the authenticated tenant ID.

methods.name: applyTenantFilter
methods.description: Helper function to add tenant filtering to MongoDB queries or filter objects, preventing cross-tenant data leakage.
